name: inverter_air_water_heat_pump
title: Inverter air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type), heating mode
summary: Detailed steady-state model of an inverter-driven reversible air-to-water heat pump (Daikin Altherma type, 2007): inverter compressor with isentropic and isochoric compression stages, effectiveness heat exchangers, fan and pump characteristics, frost/ice correction. Heating-mode branch of the original two-mode (SUBPROGRAM) file, flattened per decision D10.

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, file initials VLD)

verification.reference: EES stored solution (226 of 492 variables); partly self-inconsistent (condenser dew point 18.5 °C vs water heated to 42 °C), see README
verification.notes: Native file blocked by CS-GAP-IF5 (five-argument IF built-in, 14 call sites; gap registered). The _coolsolve variant (rewrites only the IF calls) solves 180 of 181 blocks; the 151-variable wet/dry selection block fails (Unknown fluid '' on two-phase (x,P) calls / MaxIterations; no .sol committed).
